translation: Took place in posad Serock, 11 October 1890, in the first hour after noon. Appeared personally Abram Wajngrod, synagogue beadle, 65, and Mortka Wajngrod, trader, 33, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday died a child of male sex named Moszek Wajngrod, four years old, son of Srul and Ruchla whose maiden name is unknown. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Moszek Wajngrod this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by them.
